title: I Left the Cafe Review With the Wrong-Order Cup Photo

parts.text: I waited for OAT LATTE at 8:44 a.m. and the cup said whole milk with someone else's joke name. Barista Flynn said cups were vibes. I was twenty-eight, regular, holding the order screen. I photographed the cup, the screen, and the milk. Then I left the review with the photo and the time. Flynn remade it and started writing drinks like the screen. The board finally looks like an order, not a bit. I have learned the difference between a title and a line item.

social.video_title: The cup had whole milk and a joke name — Part 1/1
social.description: Oat latte on the screen, whole milk in hand, a photo review. Has a cafe ever treated your order as a vibe?
